name: magmacrunch-website
description: magmacrunch media — dev tooling only, no build step

scripts.lint: eslint nav.js assets/*.js assets/cards/js/*.js templates/*.js arcade/shared/*.js
scripts.lint:fix: eslint --fix nav.js assets/*.js assets/cards/js/*.js templates/*.js arcade/shared/*.js
scripts.lint:all: eslint nav.js assets/*.js assets/cards/js/*.js templates/*.js arcade/shared/*.js 'arcade/**/js/*.js'
scripts.test:py: find arcade -name 'test_*.py' -exec dirname {} \; | sort -u | while read dir; do echo "=== $dir ===" && cd "$dir" && pytest -v --tb=short && cd "$OLDPWD"; done
scripts.test: npm run lint && npm run test:js
